data.name: Veo3VideoGenerationNode
data.description: Generates videos from text prompts using Google's Veo 3 API

input_details.name: aspect_ratio
input_details.tooltip: Aspect ratio of the output video

input_details.name: resolution
input_details.tooltip: Output video resolution. 4K is not available for the veo-3.1-lite model.

input_details.name: negative_prompt
input_details.tooltip: Negative text prompt to guide what to avoid in the video

input_details.name: duration_seconds
input_details.tooltip: Duration of the output video in seconds

input_details.name: enhance_prompt
input_details.tooltip: This parameter is deprecated and ignored.

input_details.name: person_generation
input_details.tooltip: Whether to allow generating people in the video

input_details.name: seed
input_details.tooltip: Seed for video generation (0 for random)

input_details.name: image
input_details.tooltip: Optional reference image to guide video generation

input_details.name: model
input_details.tooltip: Veo 3 model to use for video generation

input_details.name: generate_audio
input_details.tooltip: Generate audio for the video. Supported by all Veo 3 models.
